notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten call sheet lists the Apple Blossom Festival in Wenatchee, Darci, 509-662-3616, and darci@appleblossom.org. Current event information already lists the 2027 festival for April 22-May 2, 2027. The event also has a major carnival, so any Adventure Zone approach should be positioned as a separate staffed family attraction rather than assuming they need a carnival. Source: handwritten call notes, page 78; current event information.

followUps.label: 2027 opportunity review
followUps.reason: 2027 dates are already published. Review whether a separate family-attraction placement makes sense alongside the existing carnival before outreach.
